blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM generation through lightweight drafting and parallel verification. It is particularly promising for long inputs, where KV-cache access costs can be amortized over multiple accepted tokens. Yet most drafters are trained on short sequences and degrade on long inputs, while long-context training is costly. Existing training-free approaches restrict the context window, rescale positions, or augment recent context with retrieved distant entries. Drafters, however, read target hidden states that already encode contextual and positional information, and their lightweight architecture makes full-history attention affordable. We propose FOLD, a training-free method that preserves exact local positions and treats all distant entries as far memory at a shared position. To counter attention dilution as the memory grows, we sharpen attention within it to emphasize relevant entries while separately controlling its total weight relative to the local window. Across six target-drafter pairs and diverse benchmarks of up to 256K tokens, FOLD predominantly delivers the highest speedup, with the best case more than doubling the speedup over autoregressive decoding, from 2.08$\times$ to 4.22$\times$.
blocks.zh: 光谱解码通过轻量级的起草和平行的验证加速LLM生成. 它对于长期投入来说特别有希望,因为KV-cache访问费用可以通过多个接受的代币进行摊销。 然而,大多数起草人员都接受了短序列培训,在长时间投入下退化,而长文本培训费用高昂。 现有的无培训方法限制了上下文窗口,调整了位置,或者增加了最近检索的远程条目。 然而,起草者读取了目标隐藏状态,这些状态已经编码了背景和位置信息,并且他们的轻量级架构使得完整的历史关注可以负担得起. 我们提议FOLD,一种没有训练的方法,可以保留准确的本地位置,并将所有远处的条目都放在共享位置上. 为了对抗随着内存增加而导致注意力稀释的现象,我们在内部更加关注强调相关的条目,同时单独控制其相对于本地窗口的总重量. 在最多256K令牌的6个目标绘图人对和各种基准中,FOLD主要提供最高速度,最好的情况是将速度翻一番,而不是自动解码,从2.08美元降至4.22美元。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in long-context applications, such as long-document understanding, repository-scale coding, and agentic workflows, where inputs can span hundreds of thousands of tokens Zhu et al. (2026) ; Yang et al. (2026) .
At these lengths, attention over the KV cache becomes a major cost of decoding. For Llama-3.1-8B at 128K tokens, it takes 46% of an autoregressive (AR) decoding step, more than the weight matrix multiplications (Figure 1 ).
Speculative decoding (SD) Leviathan et al. (2023) ; Chen et al. (2023a) accelerates decoding without changing the output distribution, as a lightweight drafter proposes tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. This amortizes weight and KV cache reads over accepted tokens and pays off more as the context grows Sadhukhan et al. (2025) .
Block-parallel drafters such as DFlash Chen et al. (2026) and DSpark Cheng et al. (2026) further reduce drafting cost by proposing a block of tokens at once.

blocks.en:
Cheap drafting, however, helps only if the drafts are accepted.
Most existing drafters are trained on short sequences, for example 3K tokens for the Llama-3.1-8B DFlash drafter Chen et al. (2026) , and degrade substantially on longer inputs.
As Figure 2 shows, the speedup of the Llama-3.1-8B DFlash drafter nearly halves within 32K tokens, and that of the Gemma-4-12B drafter falls from 3.18 × \times to 1.94 × \times as LongBench v2 inputs grow beyond 128K.
Long-context fine-tuning and dedicated length-generalization training can mitigate this degradation Chen et al. (2026) ; Yang et al. (2026) , but require additional data and training for each target-drafter pair, motivating training-free adaptation of existing drafters.

blocks.en:
Prior work attributes much of this degradation to relative positions beyond the training range Chen et al. (2026) ; Yang et al. (2026) .
Training-free remedies, developed mostly for language models and partly adopted in SD, handle these positions differently.
StreamingLLM Xiao et al. (2024b) retains attention sinks and a recent window but discards the remaining history, a strategy also adopted for self-speculative drafting in MagicDec Sadhukhan et al. (2025) .
Position scaling methods such as YaRN Peng et al. (2024) , also applied to block-parallel drafters Rusanovsky et al. (2026) , retain the full context but remap all positions.
ReRoPE Su (2023) preserves exact local distances and caps distant ones, with length-dependent scaling applied to all attention logits to counter attention dilution.
InfLLM Xiao et al. (2024a) and SpecExtend Cha et al. (2026) augment recent context with retrieved distant blocks, introducing selection and refresh overhead.

blocks.en:
To address positional extrapolation, we seek to keep the drafter’s effective relative distances within its training range while retaining distant information.
Block-parallel drafters such as DFlash derive their historical keys and values from target hidden states that already encode contextual and positional information.
Our findings suggest that distant states can serve as content-bearing memory at bounded distances, while precise local positions preserve the short-context structure needed for upcoming predictions.
Reading this memory in full is also affordable for the lightweight drafter, whose KV-cache attention accounts for only a small fraction of SD-round latency (Figure 1 ).
Retaining all history thus avoids selection and refresh overhead that can offset the savings from attending to fewer entries and erode SD speedup.
blocks.zh:
为了处理位置推断问题,我们力求将起草者的有效相对距离保持在培训范围内,同时保留远处的信息。
DFlash等块平行起草器从已编码上下文和位置信息的目标隐藏状态中获取其历史键和值.
我们的调查结果表明,遥远的状态可以在有限度的距离上起到内存的作用,而准确的局部位置则保留了即将到来的预测所需的短文结构.
完全读取这个内存对于轻量级的起草者来说也是负担得起的,其KV-cache的注意力只占了自毁回旋延迟的一小部分(图一.
因此,保留所有历史可以避免选择和刷新间接费用,从而可以抵消因处理较少条目而节省的费用并削弱自毁速度。

blocks.en:
Building on this view, we propose FOLD, a training-free method that preserves exact relative positions within a local window to retain the positional structure learned on short sequences and maps all distant entries to a shared position just beyond it, forming a far memory.
To counter attention dilution as the memory grows, FOLD normalizes the window and the memory separately and uses a concentration factor α \alpha to control both how attention is distributed within the memory and how much total weight it receives.
FOLD leaves target-model verification unchanged and recovers the original attention computation when the context fits within the window.
We evaluate FOLD across six target–drafter pairs with inputs of up to 256K tokens. On seven long-context benchmarks, it consistently raises the average speedup over AR decoding of the original drafters, by 9% to 61% across Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3.5-9B, and Gemma-4-12B.
The gains also extend to DSpark drafters and the SGLang inference engine. Our contributions are as follows:

为了对付随着内存增长的注意力稀释,FOLD将窗口和内存分别正常化,并使用一个集中系数α\α来控制内存中注意力的分配方式和总重量.
FOLD将目标模型校验保留不变,当上下文适合窗口时会恢复原始的注意力计算.
我们用最多256K个信使来评估FOLD。 在7个长文基准上,它持续地将原起草者的AR解码的平均速度提高9%至61%,跨越了Llama-3.1-8B,Qune3.5-9B和Gemma-4-12B.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Speculative Decoding for Long Contexts
blocks.zh: 2.1 长上下文的分光解码

blocks.en:
Speculative decoding Leviathan et al. (2023) ; Chen et al. (2023a) accelerates generation as a lightweight drafter proposes tokens that the target model verifies in parallel, without changing the output distribution.
Recent drafters condition on target hidden features and draft either autoregressively Li et al. (2025) or a whole block at once Chen et al. (2026) ; Huang et al. (2026) ; Cheng et al. (2026) .
Long inputs make SD more valuable, as KV-cache reads are amortized over accepted tokens Sadhukhan et al. (2025) , yet drafters trained on short sequences lose much of their acceptance length on such inputs Cha et al. (2026) ; Chen et al. (2026) .
Existing remedies mostly target autoregressive drafting: self-speculative methods draft with the target model over a sparse KV cache Sadhukhan et al. (2025) ; Sun et al. (2024) ; Yue et al. (2026) , while separate drafters are trained for length generalization Yang et al. (2026) or read context selected by target attention Cha et al. (2026) .
Block-parallel drafters have been adapted through long-context fine-tuning Chen et al. (2026) , inference-time RoPE scaling Rusanovsky et al. (2026) , or sliding-window attention Jiang et al. (2026) , with evaluations on inputs of up to 32K tokens.
Adapting pretrained block-parallel drafters of different designs to contexts beyond 100K tokens remains underexplored.

blocks.en:
Training-free context extension either adapts positional encodings, through rotary rescaling Chen et al. (2023b) ; Peng et al. (2024) and relative-position remapping Su (2023) ; Jin et al. (2024) ; An et al. (2024) ; An et al. (2025) ; Tang et al. (2026) , or restricts the attended context, through attention sinks with a recent window Han et al. (2024) ; Xiao et al. (2024b) and retrieval of distant blocks Xiao et al. (2024a) . Several of these methods keep exact positions locally and coarsen distant ones, by grouping in Self-Extend Jin et al. (2024) or by assigning all distant tokens one shared distance in ReRoPE Su (2023) and InfLLM Xiao et al. (2024a) , the treatment closest to FOLD.
FOLD applies this separation to feature-conditioned drafting, motivated by the coarse position already encoded in target hidden states (§ 3.2 ).
Unlike ReRoPE, it normalizes the distant memory separately from the window, and unlike InfLLM, it reads every distant entry, since attending to the full history is cheaper for a drafter than retrieval.

Drafters are typically trained on target-generated sequences of only a few thousand tokens.
Unlike a standalone language model, the drafter reads features c j c_{j} rather than raw tokens, with each x j x_{j} already contextualized within the ordered prefix.
Despite this target-side contextualization, the logit still depends on the relative distance p − j p-j , which for distant entries can far exceed the range seen in training, placing them outside the drafter’s learned positional regime, where they can disrupt the attention patterns learned on short contexts.
blocks.zh:
起草者通常只接受几千个符号的目标生成序列的培训。
与独立语言模型不同的是,起草者读取了titlec j c_{j}而不是原始的符号,每个 x j x_{j}在所命令的前缀中已经上下文了.
尽管有这种目标侧背景化,但记录仍然取决于相对距离p-j p-j,对于远程条目来说,它远远可以超过训练中所看到的范围,将其置于起草者所学位置制度之外,在这种制度下,它们可以打乱从短期情况下学到的注意模式。

blocks.en: 3.2 Diagnosing Long-Context Drafting
blocks.zh: 3.2 长文起草分析

blocks.en: Two findings motivate the design of FOLD. The first isolates the effect of large relative distances on drafting, and the second probes the positional order that the context features already carry.
blocks.zh: 两个结论激励着FOLD的设计. 第一种分离出相去相去相去相去较大对起草的影响,第二种探测到上下文特征已经所携带的位置顺序.

blocks.en:
To isolate the effect of distance from that of context content, we shift the draft block by 8K–128K positions relative to all committed entries while keeping the content and all within-block distances fixed (Appendix A ).
On 2K-token SPEED-Bench Abramovich et al. (2026) inputs, this intervention reduces the fraction of accepted draft tokens from 0.351 to at most 0.014 for Llama-3.1-8B and from 0.241 to at most 0.076 for Gemma-4-12B.
Thus, increasing relative distances alone can sharply reduce draft acceptance.
blocks.zh:
为了隔离与上下文内容相去甚远的影响,我们将草稿块的位置相对于所有已承诺的条目移出8K-128K,同时保持内容和所有区块内距离的固定(附录A.).
在2K-token SPEED-Bench Abramovich等(2026年)投入中,这一干预将Llama-31-8B的被接受代币从0.351分减少到了最多0.014分,Gemma-4-12B的被接受代币从0.241分减少到了最多0.076分.
因此,单靠相对距离的扩大就能够使草案的接受程度急剧下降。

blocks.en:
A linear probe trained on c i − c j c_{i}-c_{j} predicts the order of two Llama-3.1-8B context entries with 94–96% accuracy when they are separated by at least 16K tokens, but performs near chance (51%) at separations of 64–256 tokens, while the corresponding probe on token embeddings remains at chance (Figure 3 ).
When 𝒯 \mathcal{T} processes the same entries in a shuffled order, the probe recovers this processing order with 84–86% accuracy, but the original order with only 52%.
This suggests that coarse positional information is written into c j c_{j} through 𝒯 \mathcal{T} ’s position-aware computation Haviv et al. (2022) .

blocks.en: Together, these findings motivate retaining precise positional order near the draft block while reading distant entries through their contextualized features, without imposing extrapolated distances.

blocks.en:
Guided by these findings, FOLD splits the drafter’s context into a recent window and a far memory (Figure 4 ).
This split reflects the different roles of recent and distant context during generation.
Recent context supports the syntax, style, and discourse trajectory of the local continuation, where precise token order matters.
Distant context instead serves primarily as a content-addressable memory for retrieving earlier facts and evidence, where preserving information matters more than exact relative distances.
FOLD changes only how the drafter attends to its context, leaving the drafter’s weights, the target model, and verification unchanged.
It has two inference-time hyperparameters, the window size W W and the concentration factor α \alpha .
blocks.zh:
根据这些调查结果,FOLD将起草者的背景分成了最近的窗口和遥远的内存(图4).
这种分化反映了近代和远代背景的不同作用.
最近的上下文支持当地续作的语法,风格,和会话轨迹,其中精确的符号顺序很重要.
相反,不同背景主要起到可处理内容的内存作用,用于检索先前的事实和证据,在这些方面,保存信息比确切的相对距离更重要。
FOLD只改变起草者对待其上下文的方式,使起草者的权重,目标模型和校验不变.
它有两个推断时间超参数,窗口大小为WW和浓度系数为α-α.

blocks.en:
FOLD is training-free and leaves the target model and verification unchanged.
Every layer using FOLD reads its local window and the entire far memory, without retrieval or selection refresh.
For drafters mixing sliding-window and full-attention layers, FOLD can be applied to the full-attention layers alone or to all layers.
In the latter case, each sliding-window layer retains its native window as the local branch and additionally reads the far memory.

每个使用 FOLD 的图层都会读取其本地窗口和整个远内存,而不进行检索或选择刷新.
对于将滑窗和全意层相混合的起草者,FOLD可以单独应用于全意层或所有层.
在后一种情况下,每个滑动-窗口层保留其本地窗口作为本地分支,并额外读取了远方的内存.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en:
We evaluate four target models with released block-parallel drafters of different designs (Table 1 ).
Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct Grattafiori et al. (2024) and Qwen3.5-9B Qwen Team (2026) use the DFlash drafters of z-lab, and Gemma-4-12B-it Google DeepMind (2026) and Qwen3-8B Yang et al. (2025) use the DFlash and DSpark Cheng et al. (2026) drafters of DeepSpec DeepSeek-AI (2026) .
For every drafter, FOLD uses the window W W in Table 1 , fixed before evaluation, and α = 2 \alpha=2 .

我们评估四种目标模型,并发布不同设计的块相平行起草器(表1)。
Llama-3.1-8B-Grattafiori等人(2024年)和Quen3.5-9B Quen Team (2026)使用z-lab的DFlash起草人,而Gemma-4-12B-it Google DeepMind (2026)和Qwen3-8B Yang等 (2025)使用DFlash和DSpark Cheng等 (2026) DepSpec DeepSeek-AI (2026)的起草人.
对于每个起草者,FOLD使用表1中的窗口WW,在评价前固定,而α=2\alpha=2.

blocks.en:
We evaluate seven benchmarks with inputs of about 1K to 256K tokens, grouped into general and code tasks.
The general tasks are GovReport from LongBench-E (Gov) Bai et al. (2024) , LongBench v2 (LBv2) Bai et al. (2025) , and five InfiniteBench Zhang et al. (2024) tasks, namely KV retrieval (Retr.KV) and the English summarization (En.Sum), QA (En.QA), multiple choice (En.MC), and dialogue QA (En.Dia) tasks, whose average we report as En.
The code tasks are repository-level code continuation from Long Code Arena (LCA) Bogomolov et al. (2024) at 32K, 64K, and 122K tokens, cross-file completion from RepoBench Liu et al. (2024) , and patch generation from SWE-bench Jimenez et al. (2024) .
For the length analysis, we add LCA inputs of 180K and 240K tokens and group LBv2 requests by length.
Requests exceeding a model’s context limit are excluded (Appendix B.2 ).

All baselines keep the original drafter and change only how it reads its context: StreamingLLM Xiao et al. (2024b) truncates the context, YaRN Peng et al. We adapt ReRoPE and InfLLM from language models as baselines with closely related treatments of distant positions.
We call the original drafters DFlash and DSpark (Appendix B.3 ).

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
FOLD achieves the highest average τ \tau and speedup on all three models (Table 2 ), raising the average speedup of the original drafters from 2.11 × \times to 3.40 × \times on Llama-3.1-8B, from 2.98 × \times to 3.39 × \times on Qwen3.5-9B, and from 2.46 × \times to 2.68 × \times on Gemma-4-12B.
The gain is largest on Llama-3.1-8B, whose drafter degrades most on long inputs.
FOLD and ReRoPE, which both retain the full context while bounding its positions, rank first and second in average speedup on all three models.
The retrieval baselines can attain comparable or higher τ \tau , as CMR does on Retr.KV for Qwen3.5-9B, but their selection and refresh overhead lowers their speedup.
On Retr.KV, where drafts must reproduce values stored in distant context, FOLD is the fastest method on all three models.
On the Gov, LBv2, Retr.KV, and En.Sum requests of Llama-3.1-8B, an SD round takes 12.3 ms with FOLD, 0.3 ms more than with DFlash and less than with InfLLM (13.7 ms) and CMR (14.0 ms).
The side cache is at most about 6.0 GiB, on Qwen3.5-9B at its maximum context length with all six drafter layers reading the memory (Appendix B.4 ).

blocks.en:
Figure 5 breaks the speedup down by input length on LCA (32K–240K tokens) and LBv2 (10K–250K tokens).
On LCA, the original drafters slow down as the input grows, and the gain of FOLD over them widens from 32K to 122K tokens on all three models.
On Llama-3.1-8B, FOLD raises the speedup from 2.82 × \times to 4.64 × \times at 32K tokens and from 2.08 × \times to 4.22 × \times at 122K, and on Qwen3.5-9B it stays at 5.67–5.68 × \times from 32K to 122K.
Among the baselines, YaRN declines fastest on Llama-3.1-8B and Gemma-4-12B, and ReRoPE declines with length on Qwen3.5-9B, from 5.37 × \times to 4.59 × \times on LCA and to 2.52 × \times beyond 128K tokens on LBv2.
The relative performance of StreamingLLM, which keeps only recent entries, depends strongly on the model: it is the fastest method at four of the five LCA lengths on Gemma-4-12B but slower than DFlash on Qwen3.5-9B up to 64K tokens.
Where DFlash barely degrades, as on LBv2 inputs below 16K tokens for Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma-4-12B, FOLD has little to gain and is slightly slower.
We also report results on SPEED-Bench (Appendix C.1 ).

With DSpark drafters (Table 3 ), FOLD achieves the highest speedup on the general tasks of both models, raising it from 3.41 × \times to 3.63 × \times on Qwen3-8B and from 2.62 × \times to 2.83 × \times on Gemma-4-12B.

blocks.en: 4.3 Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 分析

blocks.en:
To examine the roles of the window and the memory, we compare FOLD with Window, which keeps the window of FOLD but drops the distant entries (Table 4 ).
On LCA, FOLD exceeds Window by 0.15–1.29 in τ \tau for all three drafters and all three lengths.
The window alone behaves differently across drafters. It raises τ \tau by 1.07–1.53 on Llama-3.1-8B, more on longer inputs, and by 0.09–0.36 on Gemma-4-12B, whereas on Qwen3.5-9B it lowers τ \tau by 0.22 and 0.08 at 32K and 64K and raises it by 0.15 at 122K.
The memory contributes 0.93–1.07 on Llama-3.1-8B. On Qwen3.5-9B it contributes 1.11–1.29 and thus most or all of the gain over DFlash, suggesting that distant context can aid drafting without retaining its exact relative positions.
On LBv2, the memory raises τ \tau on Gemma-4-12B and Qwen3.5-9B, whereas its gain shrinks with length on Llama-3.1-8B and it lowers τ \tau on Qwen3-8B (Appendix D.1 ).

blocks.en:
Setting α = 1 \alpha=1 keeps the position mapping of FOLD but normalizes the window and the memory in a single softmax.
For N N equally scored distant entries, the memory mass then scales linearly with N N , compared with N \sqrt{N} under the default α = 2 \alpha=2 (§ 3.3 ).
Increasing α \alpha both sharpens attention within the memory and tempers its aggregate mass relative to the window.
Raising α \alpha from 1 to 2 yields mean per-request τ \tau ratios above 1 across all task groups in Table 5 , with the largest gains on Qwen3.5-9B, where the ratios reach 2.79 on the general tasks and 4.17 on the code tasks.
On this drafter, both settings read the same distant entries in all six layers.
Yet on LBv2, α = 1 \alpha=1 yields a τ \tau of only 1.65, below DFlash’s 4.28, whereas α = 2 \alpha=2 reaches 4.62.
These results indicate strong sensitivity to memory normalization.
Since ReRoPE also normalizes the window and distant entries jointly, this sensitivity may help explain its decline with input length on this drafter (Figure 5 ).
Raising α \alpha further from 2 to 4 keeps the mean ratio within 2% of 1 in no consistent direction on the other task groups, but yields 1.146 on Qwen3.5-9B’s general tasks.
A larger α \alpha can therefore provide further gains, although its benefit depends on both the drafter and the task.

blocks.en:
FOLD complements long-context training.
Although the Qwen3.5-9B drafter is trained on 40K-token sequences with sliding windows, FOLD raises its τ \tau on all seven benchmarks.
Training length alone does not explain the variation in gains.
The Llama-3.1-8B and Gemma-4-12B drafters are both trained on short sequences, yet FOLD raises their τ \tau by 0.86–2.28 and by at most 0.75.
Beyond distances and distant information, which FOLD addresses, drafting is also affected by the target itself, whose features and predictions change with input length.
On LCA, even StreamingLLM, whose positions are bounded, loses τ \tau as inputs grow, suggesting that positional extrapolation is not the only cause of degradation (Appendix C.1 ).
Differences in target model, training data, and drafter architecture may thus all contribute.
Across these differences, FOLD attains the highest average speedup on all three models in Table 2 and the highest or tied-highest speedup with DSpark drafters (Table 3 ).

FOLD是对长文本培训的补充.
虽然Quen3.5-9B的起草器在有滑动窗口的40K-token序列上接受了训练,但FOLD却在所有七个基准上提升了它的\tau.
培训时间本身不能解释收益的变化。
Llama-3.1-8B和Gemma-4-12号 B起草者都接受过短序列的培训,然而FOLD却将他们的\\tau提高0.86–2.28并最多提高0.75.
FOLD所处理的超出距离和遥远的信息,起草工作也受到目标本身的影响,其特征和预测随着输入长度而变化.
在LCA上,即使StreatingLLM(其位置是受约束的),也随着投入的增加而失去\tau,说明位置外推并不是退化的唯一原因(附录C.1 )。
因此,目标模式、培训数据和起草者结构方面的差异都可能造成影响。
通过这些差异,FOLD在表2中所有三种模型的平均速度都达到最高,用DSpark起草器达到最高或捆绑最高速度(表3)。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Our results show that drafters trained on short sequences can accelerate long-context decoding without retraining.
Because a drafter reads target hidden states computed over the full prefix, FOLD keeps exact positions only within a local window and reads older entries as a far memory whose weight a concentration factor controls.
On diverse drafters and inputs of up to 256K tokens, it consistently improves SD and is the most robust method across models.
Drafters can thus inherit the long-context ability of their target models, which shifts the open question from how distant entries are positioned to how they are attended to.
FOLD controls how much weight they receive, and richer ways of reading the memory may exploit it further.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果显示,经过短序列培训的起草者可以不经再培训而加速长编解码.
由于一个起草者读取了目标隐藏状态在完整前缀上计算,FOLD只将精确位置保存在本地窗口内,并读取了更古老的条目作为远方的内存,其重量由集中系数控制.
在各种起草者和最多256K个信使的投入上,它一贯改进了自毁能力,是跨模型中最有力的方法。
因此,起草者可以继承其目标模型的长文本能力,从而将尚未解决的问题从远程条目的位置转移到如何处理这些条目。
FOLD控制着他们得到的分量,更丰富的阅读记忆的方法可能进一步地利用它.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Acceptance length, and hence the speedup, depends strongly on the target model and the task, so the gains of FOLD vary across models and tasks.
Because FOLD changes only how the drafter reads its context, it cannot address degradation caused by the target itself, whose features and predictions change with input length, which may limit its gains on models such as Gemma-4-12B.
We focus on block-parallel drafters and do not evaluate autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE-3 Li et al. (2025) , since block-parallel drafters have been reported to achieve substantially higher speedups Chen et al. (2026) .
FOLD also keeps an extra, unrotated copy of the drafter’s keys and values, whose size grows linearly with context length.
This overhead is small for lightweight drafters, but it can become significant under tight memory budgets or high concurrency.
The window size W W and concentration factor α \alpha are set manually and remain fixed during decoding.
Efficient adaptation of these parameters during inference is left for future work.
blocks.zh:

这种间接费用对轻量级起草者来说是很小的,但是在紧凑的内存预算或高通货率的情况下,它可能会变得显著.

这些参数在推论期间的有效调整留待今后的工作。

blocks.en: Appendix A Details of the Diagnostic Experiments
blocks.zh: 附录A 诊断实验的细节

blocks.en:
For each input, we take the greedy continuation of 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , generated beforehand with vLLM, and obtain the context features c j c_{j} at all positions from a single forward pass of 𝒯 \mathcal{T} over the input and the continuation.
At a position t t of the continuation, each variant drafts a block from the features of x < t x_{<t} , so all variants are compared on identical states.
Acceptance length τ fs \tau_{\mathrm{fs}} is one plus the number of leading draft tokens that match the continuation, averaged over positions and then over inputs.
All diagnostics use a PyTorch Paszke et al. (2019) reference implementation of the drafter without any component of FOLD.
blocks.zh:
对于每个输入,我们取用预先用 vLLM 生成的 T\ mathcal{ T} 的贪婪延续, 并从 T\ mathcal{ T} 在输入和延续的单个前行获得所有位置的上下文特性 cj\j} 。
在续作的tt位置上,每个变体会从x < t x_{<t}的特征中起草一个块,因此所有变体都比较到相同的状态.
接受长度 \ tau\ mathrm{ fs} 是 1 , 加上与续作相匹配的主要草稿符号数, 平均值为位置和输入值 。
所有诊断都使用PyTorch Paszke等人(2019年)在不包含FOLD任何组件的情况下对起草器的参考执行.

blocks.en:
We evaluate 16 SPEED-Bench 2K inputs at two decoding positions per input.
At each position, we shift the position IDs of the entire draft block forward by 8K, 32K, or 128K while leaving those of the committed entries unchanged.
This intervention increases the distance from the draft block to every context entry while preserving both the content and all within-block distances.
We report the draft acceptance fraction a = min ⁡ ( L , K ) / K a=\min(L,K)/K , where L L is the number of leading matches and K K is the number of scored draft tokens: 9 for Llama-3.1-8B and 7 for Gemma-4-12B.
Unlike τ fs \tau_{\mathrm{fs}} , a a excludes the additional token sampled by 𝒯 \mathcal{T} .
For Gemma-4-12B, the paired-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals for the change in a a relative to the unshifted baseline lie entirely below zero at all three shifts.
blocks.zh:
我们评价16个SPEED-Bench 2K输入,每输入两个解码位置。
在每一个位置,我们把整个区划草稿的位置ID向前移动8K,32K,或128K,而承诺的条目则保持不变.
这种干预增加了从区块草稿到每个上下文条目的距离,同时保留了内容和所有区块内距离.
我们报告接受草案的分数 a = min = (L, K ) / K a = (L, K ) / K ,其中 L L 为领先匹配数, K K 为得分的草稿令牌数 : 9为Llama-3.1-8B,7为Gemma-4-12B.
与 fs\ tau\ mathrm{ fs} 不同的是, 一个排除了 T\ mathcal{ T} 所选取的额外符号 。
对于Gemma-4-12B来说,相对于未转移基线的变化,组合-波斯特拉95%的置信间隔在所有三班完全低于零。

blocks.en:
For each of SPEED-Bench 32K and LongBench v2, we evaluate 20 Llama-3.1-8B inputs using five-fold cross-validation over inputs, with 16 inputs for training and four for testing in each fold.
Outside the most recent 2,048 entries, we sample 1,500 pairs per input from each of five separation bins spanning 64 to 64K tokens.
One LongBench v2 input contains no eligible pair in the farthest bin and is omitted from that bin only.
A logistic-regression probe, trained with Adam for 600 steps at a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} , takes the standardized difference c i − c j c_{i}-c_{j} , or the corresponding difference of token embeddings, and predicts whether i < j i<j .
We report test accuracy averaged across folds, with a standard deviation of at most 1.8 percentage points for separations of at least 16K tokens.
For the shuffled control, we permute the older context in 64-token chunks before it is processed by 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , then realign each resulting feature with its original token.

LCA uses the large-context split of the Long Code Arena project-level code completion benchmark Bogomolov et al. (2024) , which pairs a Python file with a snapshot of its repository, and its huge-context split for the 180K and 240K inputs.
Each file is cut before the first line that contains a function or class from the repository and is preceded by at least 50 lines.
The input places the other Python files of the repository before the prefix of the cut file, each headed by a comment with its path, with files nearer in the directory tree placed closer to the prefix.
Files are added from the nearest until the input reaches exactly 32K, 64K, 122K, 180K, or 240K tokens, and the farthest added file is truncated from its start.
We keep every eligible example of the large-context split and the first 48 eligible examples per length of the huge-context split.
RepoBench uses the cross-file-first split of RepoBench v1.1 Liu et al. (2024) for Python and Java, in which the line to complete is the first use of a definition from another file, with the official prompt that places code snippets from other files before the imports and preceding lines of the current file.
We take its 32k, 64k, and 128k levels, which the benchmark defines with its own tokenizer, keep one example per file, and use all Python files and a random sample of 134 Java files per level.
SWE-bench uses a random sample of 288 test instances of SWE-bench Jimenez et al. (2024) with the BM25-retrieved code context of its 40K-token setting, from which the target writes a patch that resolves the issue.
LCA and RepoBench inputs are raw text without a chat template, whereas SWE-bench prompts use the chat template of the general tasks.
Random samples take the first examples in a fixed hash order of their identifiers.

blocks.en:
All baselines modify only how the drafter attends to its context and leave the target model and verification unchanged. • StreamingLLM Xiao et al. (2024b) keeps the first 4 context entries as attention sinks and the 2,044 most recent entries (2,048 in total). The retained entries are renumbered consecutively, and the block positions follow them. • YaRN Peng et al. (2024) attends to the full context with a per-request scaling factor max ⁡ ( 1 , ⌈ ( P + G + Q ) / 256 ⌉ ⋅ 256 / R ) \max\big(1,\lceil(P+G+Q)/256\rceil\cdot 256/R\big) , where P P is the input length, G G the generation limit, Q Q the number of block positions, and R R the reference length (3,072 for Llama-3.1-8B, 40,000 for Qwen3.5-9B, and 4,096 for Gemma-4-12B and Qwen3-8B). • ReRoPE Su (2023) keeps true distances within the window 𝒩 p \mathcal{N}_{p} of FOLD, assigns every older entry the distance D D at all block positions, and scales every query in every drafter layer by max ⁡ ( 1 , log ⁡ ( p + 1 ) / log ⁡ 4096 ) \max\big(1,\log(p+1)/\log 4096\big) . The window and the older entries are normalized by a single softmax. • CMR is the cross-model retrieval of SpecExtend Cha et al. (2026) , adapted to block-parallel drafting with the defaults of its official EAGLE implementation. The context is divided into consecutive chunks of 32 entries. The first draft block after prefill reads the 64 most recent chunks, and the selection is refreshed every 8 rounds. At a refresh for anchor x t x_{t} , CMR averages over heads the attention weights of the target query at position t − 1 t-1 in the target’s last full-attention layer, taken from the preceding verification, and selects the 64 chunks with the highest mean weight (2,048 entries). Between refreshes, each newly started chunk is added to the selection and extended as entries are committed. The selected entries are renumbered consecutively in chronological order, and the B B block positions follow them. All drafter layers read the same selection, including the sliding-window layers of the Qwen3.5-9B drafter. • InfLLM Xiao et al. (2024a) follows its official implementation and configuration (blocks of 128 entries, 128 initial entries, 16 retrieved blocks, and 4 representative entries per block) and uses the window 𝒩 p \mathcal{N}_{p} of FOLD as its local window. Entries that leave the window are grouped into blocks. Each block is represented by the mean key of the 4 entries that received the most attention while inside the window, and blocks whose entries never entered the window, which include most of a long input, use the mean key of all their entries. In every round and layer, the block queries, averaged over positions, select the 16 blocks whose representations have the largest inner product with them. The initial entries, the selected blocks, and the older entries not yet grouped into a block are all placed at the largest local distance D − 1 D-1 and attended together with the window under a single softmax. Memory is kept on the GPU without CPU offloading. StreamingLLM and CMR use a budget of 2,048 entries for all models, as in their standard configurations, whereas FOLD, ReRoPE, and InfLLM use the window W W of each model.
The ablation variant Window used in § 4.3 attends only to the window 𝒩 p \mathcal{N}_{p} of FOLD, i.e., FOLD without its far memory.
The Qwen3.5-9B drafter reads the full context only in its last layer, while its five sliding-window layers read the 4,096 most recent entries.
FOLD and ReRoPE are applied to all six layers, so that each sliding-window layer keeps its native sliding window for nearby entries and additionally reads the older entries at the shared distant position.
StreamingLLM, YaRN, and InfLLM are applied to the full-attention layer alone, since the sliding-window layers never exceed their trained distances and InfLLM would otherwise retrieve in every layer.
These choices also gave the higher speedup in our evaluation.
CMR retrieves on the target side and, as in its original design, every drafter layer reads only the selected entries.
For this drafter, DFlash and YaRN use the storage-matched implementation described in Appendix B.4 .
The DSpark drafters use the same configurations as the DFlash drafters of the same target.

blocks.zh: CMR是SpecExtend Cha等(2026年)的跨模型检索,被调整为块-平行起草,默认其EAGLE正式实施. 上下文分为连续块32个条目. 预填后的第一稿块读取了最近64个块,每8个回合刷新选择. 在 socket xt xXXt} 的刷新时, CMR 平均值在目标最后全注层 t − 1 t-1位置上标出目标查询的注意力权重, 取自前次验证, 并选择64个平均重量最高的块(2 048个条目)。 在刷新之间,每个新开始的块会被添加到选择中,并在输入时被扩展. 所选条目按时间顺序相继重新编号,而B B块位置则跟随. 所有起草器层读取相同的选择,包括Quen3.5-9B起草器的滑动-窗口层.

blocks.en: InfLLM Xiao et al. (2024a) follows its official implementation and configuration (blocks of 128 entries, 128 initial entries, 16 retrieved blocks, and 4 representative entries per block) and uses the window 𝒩 p \mathcal{N}_{p} of FOLD as its local window. Entries that leave the window are grouped into blocks. Each block is represented by the mean key of the 4 entries that received the most attention while inside the window, and blocks whose entries never entered the window, which include most of a long input, use the mean key of all their entries. In every round and layer, the block queries, averaged over positions, select the 16 blocks whose representations have the largest inner product with them. The initial entries, the selected blocks, and the older entries not yet grouped into a block are all placed at the largest local distance D − 1 D-1 and attended together with the window under a single softmax. Memory is kept on the GPU without CPU offloading.
blocks.zh: IfLLLM (英语). Xiao等 (2024a)遵循其正式实施和配置(以128个条目为块,128个初始条目为块,16个被检索出块,每个块有4个代表性条目),并使用FOLD的窗口N p\mathcal{N}_{p}作为其本地窗口. 离开窗口的条目被分组为块. 每个块由4个条目在窗口内部得到最多关注的中间键来代表,而其条目从未进入窗口的块,包含大部分长长的输入,则使用他们所有条目的中间键. 在每一回合和每一层中,区块查询,平均在位置上,选择16个区块,这些区块的表示与它们一起拥有最大的内出产. 最初的条目,所选的块,以及尚未被组合成块的更古老的条目,均被放入最大局域距离D−1 D-1,并连同窗口一起被放在一个单一软max下. 内存保存在GPU上,没有CPU卸载.

blocks.en: B.4 Implementation
blocks.zh: B.4 执行情况

blocks.en:
All methods run in vLLM 0.28.0 on a single NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 GPU with batch size 1, BF16 precision, CUDA graphs, chunked prefill of 8,192 tokens, and greedy decoding.
Each method is timed against an AR run of the same requests on the same GPU.
For each attention read of the drafter, the number of FlashAttention Dao et al. (2022) splits is chosen from { 1 , 8 , 16 , 32 , 64 } \{1,8,16,32,64\} by a microbenchmark on synthetic inputs with the actual attention shapes of that read. Methods that use the same read, namely FOLD, Window, ReRoPE, and the local read of InfLLM, share the chosen value.
blocks.zh:
所有方法在单NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 GPU上运行于vLLM 0.28.0中,分批尺寸为1,BF16精度,CUDA图,分批预装出8,192个符,并有贪婪的解码.
每种方法都根据同一GPU上相同请求的AR跑来定时.
将每一注意改为起草者,即FlashAttenty Dao等的编号。 (2022)分数取自{ 1, 8, 16, 32, 64}} \{ 1, 8, 16, 32, 64}由合成输入物上的一个微分标, 其实际注意形状为该读取. 使用相同读取的方法,即FOLD,Window,ReRoPE,以及本地读取的InfLLM,共享所选值.

blocks.en:
FOLD reads the window with one FlashAttention call over the drafter’s KV cache and the far memory with a second call over a side cache, which stores the unrotated keys and the values of all committed entries.
The side cache is filled as entries are committed, and its keys are never re-rotated.
Fused Triton Tillet et al. (2019) kernels rotate the queries and merge the two outputs (Eqs. 2 – 4 ), and all kernels run within CUDA graphs.
At the maximum context length, the side cache takes 2.5 GiB in BF16 for Llama-3.1-8B and Gemma-4-12B, 0.63 GiB for Qwen3-8B, and 6.0 GiB for Qwen3.5-9B, or 1.0 GiB when only its full-attention layer reads the memory, which lowers its speedup averaged over the seven general tasks from 2.43 × \times to 2.33 × \times .
blocks.zh:
FOLD 在起草者的 KV 缓存上读取一个 FlashAttention 调用窗口, 在远方的内存上读取第二个调用侧缓存, 它存储所有已承诺条目的未旋转密钥和值 。
侧缓存随着条目的被承诺而被填充,其密钥永远不会被再旋转.
废三通 Tillet等 (2019)内核旋转查询并合并了两个输出(Eqs. 2 – 4),所有内核运行在 CUDA 图中.
在最大上下文长度下,侧缓存为:Llama-31-8B和Gemma-4-12B取2.5 GiB;Qune3-8B取0.63 GiB;Qune3.5-9B取6.0 GiB;或只有全心全意地分层读取内存时取1.0 GiB;这将7个一般任务的速率平均值从2.43××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××等.

blocks.en:
With length dispatch, the drafter runs a separate window-only CUDA graph while the sequence is no longer than W W and switches to the FOLD graph once the sequence grows beyond W W .
Because the side cache is updated in every round, the far memory is complete at the switch.
We evaluate the dispatch on the 1K and 2K tiers and the first turns of the qualitative split of SPEED-Bench.
Requests that stay within the window produce the same outputs and τ \tau as the original drafter and run about 1% slower on Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma-4-12B.
blocks.zh:
随着长度调度,起草者运行一个单独的只窗口的 CUDA 图形,而序列不长于W W,并在序列超过W W 时切换到FOLD 图形.
因为边缓存在每个回合中都会被更新,所以在开关时最远的内存是完整的.
我们评估1K级和2K级的发送情况,以及SPEED-Bench在质量上的分化的第一回合。
要求留在窗口内产生与原起草器相同的输出和\tau,并在Llama-3.1-8B,Qune3-8B,和Gemma-4-12B上运行速度较慢约1%.

blocks.en:
For the Qwen3.5-9B drafter, the stock DFlash implementation in vLLM uses different KV-cache storage, grouping, and attention wrappers from FOLD.
To control for these implementation differences, we evaluate DFlash and YaRN for this model using the same KV-cache storage and grouping scheme and the same FlashAttention wrapper as FOLD.
blocks.zh:
对于Quen3.5-9B起草器,vLLM中的股票 DFlash执行使用不同的KV-cache存储,分组,以及FOLD的注意力包装.
为了控制这些执行差异,我们使用相同的KV-cache存储和分组方案以及FOLD相同的闪存包来评价DFlash和YARN这个模型.

blocks.en: B.5 Statistics
blocks.zh: B.5 统计

blocks.en:
For each request, acceptance length τ \tau is the average number of tokens committed per verification round, including the token sampled by 𝒯 \mathcal{T} .
We report its mean across requests.
Time per output token (TPOT) is the decoding time after the first output token divided by the number of subsequent output tokens, excluding prefill.
We compute speedup for each request as TPOT AR / TPOT method \mathrm{TPOT}_{\mathrm{AR}}/\mathrm{TPOT}_{\mathrm{method}} and report the mean of these ratios across requests.
Results are averaged with equal weight across benchmarks, and En. averages its four tasks with equal weight.
The side-cache comparison in Appendix B.4 and the SGLang results in Appendix C.3 instead weight the seven general tasks equally.
For paired comparisons, we report 95% bootstrap confidence intervals using 2,000 resamples of paired requests with replacement and a fixed random seed.
For averages across tasks, requests are resampled separately within each task.
blocks.zh:
对于每个请求,接受长度为\tau是每个验证回合承诺的平均符号数,包括由T\mathcal{T}抽取的符号.
我们报告它的各种要求的恶行。
每个输出令牌的时间(TPOT)是第一个输出令牌后除以后续输出令牌数量后再解码的时间,不包括预填.
我们计算每个请求的速度为 TPOT AR / TPOT 方法\ mathrm{ TPOT} mathrm{ AR}}/\ mathrm{ TPOT} mathrm{ 方法} 并报告这些比率的平均值。
En. 平均完成四项任务。
附录B.4中的侧切比较和SGLang中的结果为附录C.3,相反,对7个一般任务的加权相等。
对于配对比较,我们报告95%的靴子置信间隔,使用2000个复标的配对请求与替换和一个固定的随机种子.
对于跨任务的平均要求,在每项任务中分别重复请求.

blocks.en:
Greedy verification preserves the AR output in exact arithmetic, but in BF16 the verification pass over a block and the AR step can differ numerically, which can change the output where the two most likely tokens nearly tie.
Such differences affect every method, including the original drafters, so the reported speedups compare decoding on the same inputs rather than on identical outputs.
blocks.zh:
贪婪的核查在精确的算术上保留了AR输出,但在BF16中,核查通过一个块,而AR步骤在数字上可以有所区别,这可以改变两个最有可能的符号相近的输出.
这种差异会影响包括原始起草者在内的每一种方法,因此所报告的速度比较了相同投入而不是相同产出的解码.

On LCA, from 32K to 122K tokens, the τ \tau of DFlash falls by 10–25% across the three drafters, that of StreamingLLM by 4–11%, and that of FOLD by 2–9%.
Table 8 adds the SPEED-Bench throughput tiers of 8K to 32K tokens.
On Llama-3.1-8B, the speedup of DFlash falls from 2.84 × \times at 8K tokens to 2.07 × \times at 32K, while FOLD and ReRoPE stay between 3.81 × \times and 4.02 × \times .

blocks.en: C.2 Qwen3-8B with DFlash
blocks.zh: C.2 带 DFlash 的 Quen3-8B

blocks.en:
Under the 32K context limit, we evaluate Qwen3-8B with DFlash on Gov and LBv2 (Table 9 ).
FOLD achieves the highest speedup on Gov (2.63 × \times ).
On LBv2, StreamingLLM outperforms FOLD (4.59 × \times vs. 4.00 × \times ), while FOLD’s window-only variant reaches 4.61 × \times with τ = 5.25 \tau=5.25 .
The advantage of windowing is consistent with LBv2’s short outputs (median 39 tokens) and prompt structure, which places the question, options, and answer format at the end.
On Gov, where summaries draw on the full report, far memory instead improves acceptance, raising τ \tau from 2.51 to 2.85 over the window alone.

在32K上下文限制下,我们用DFlash在Gov和LBv2上评价Quen3-8B(表9).

在政府方面,摘要借鉴了报告全文,而远处的内存则提高了接受程度,仅从2.51提高到2.85。

blocks.en: C.3 Results in SGLang
blocks.zh: C.3. SGLang的成果

blocks.en: To check that the gains of FOLD are not specific to our vLLM implementation, we repeat the Llama-3.1-8B evaluation in a second engine, SGLang 0.5.18 Zheng et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 为了检查FOLD的收益不是我们执行VLLM的具体结果,我们在第二个引擎中重复了Llama-3.1-8B评价,SGLang 0.5.18 郑等 (2024).

blocks.en:
We use the same target model, the same DFlash drafter with block size B = 10 B=10 , and the 1,531 Llama-3.1-8B requests of the general tasks in Table 2 , with the same token ids, generation limits, and stop tokens.
The run settings follow those of the main experiments: BF16, one request at a time, chunked prefill of 8,192 tokens, no prefix caching, CUDA graphs for the target and the drafter, and greedy decoding.
FOLD and the baselines are implemented in the SGLang drafter following their vLLM counterparts, and FOLD uses W = 2,048 W=2{,}048 and α = 2 \alpha=2 .
We also report SGLang’s built-in draft window, which restricts all block positions to one window of 2,048 entries, and Window, which keeps the window of FOLD without its far memory.
YaRN is omitted, as its SGLang implementation did not pass our numerical consistency checks.
Every method is paired with an AR run on the same GPU, and the speedup is computed as in the main experiments.
blocks.zh:
我们使用相同的目标模型,相同的DFlash起草器,以块大小 B = 10 B = 10,以及表2中一般任务的1,531 Llama-3.1-8B请求,具有相同的同义代号,生成限制,并停止发号.
运行设置遵循了主要实验的设置: BF16,一次一个请求,将预填出8,192个令牌,没有前缀活塞,CUDA图形用于目标和起草者,以及贪婪地解码.
FOLD和基线在SGLang的起草器中按照它们的vLLM对应程序执行,FOLD使用W=2,048 W=2{,}048和α=2\alpha=2.
我们还报告SGLang的内置草稿窗口,它将所有块位置限制在一个有2 048个条目的窗口,以及将FOLD的窗口保留在远离内存的窗口。
YARN省略了,因为其SGLang的执行没有通过我们的数字一致性检查。
每种方法都与同一种GPU上的AR运行相配,并像主实验一样计算出速度.

blocks.en:
As in vLLM (Appendix B.5 ), numerical differences between the drafting and AR paths can change the output when the two most likely tokens are nearly tied.
In a diagnostic run on a smaller set of requests, every difference we examined began at such a near tie.
In the full evaluation, every method, including the original drafter, differs from AR on 79 to 84 of the 1,531 requests, largely the same requests across methods (Table 10 ).
This exceeds the limit of about 2% in our original protocol, so after observing these results we report all requests without examining each difference, and the numbers compare decoding on the same inputs rather than on identical outputs.
Removing the 94 requests that differ for any method changes every average by less than 0.01 and leaves the order of the methods unchanged.
blocks.zh:
和vLLM(Appendix B.5 .)一样,当最有可能的两个符号几乎被捆绑时,起草和AR路径之间的数值差异可以改变输出.
在对一组较小的请求进行诊断时,我们所检查的每一种差异都以这种接近的比分开始。
在全面评价中,每种方法,包括最初的起草者,在1 531项请求中,79项请求与84项请求的实时评估报告不同,各方法的请求基本相同(表10)。
这超过了我们原始协议中大约2%的限度,所以在观察这些结果后,我们报告所有请求而不检查每个差异,数字比较了相同输入而不是相同输出的解码.
删除所有方法的94个不同要求,每个平均变化不到0.01个,使方法的顺序保持不变。
